name: Military Officer (CR 4)
body:
Military Officer
CR 4

XP 1,200
Elf aristocrat 6
N Medium humanoid (elf)
Init +2; Senses low-light vision; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 12, flat-footed 18 (+6 armor, +2 Dex, +2 shield)
hp 36 (6d8+9)
Fort +2, Ref +4, Will +7; +2 vs. enchantments
Immune sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee rapier +4 (1d6/18–20)
Ranged stunner +6 (1d8 nonlethal sonic) or military pistol +6 (1d8/x4)

TACTICS

Before Combat A military officer directs her troops from behind, often mounted on horseback or a similar combat-trained animal or in a vehicle, saving her personal attention for the toughest foes. She uses potions of cure light wounds to save her most wounded subordinates from death.

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 14, Con 10, Int 11, Wis 10, Cha 11
Base Atk +4; CMB +4; CMD 16
Feats Deadly Aim, Iron Will, Toughness
Skills Diplomacy +9, Intimidate +5, Knowledge (nobility) +5, Perception +8, Profession (soldier) +9, Ride +5, Sense Motive +5
Languages Common, Elven
SQ elven magic, weapon familiarity
Combat Gear potions of cure light wounds (3), potion of cure moderate wounds; Other Gear stunner, military pistol with 1 extra magazine, rapier, masterwork trooper armor, heavy wooden shield, courtier’s outfit, bit and bridle, light horse (combat trained), military saddle, saddlebags, studded leather barding, 87 gp.

A military officer is a capable and seasoned commander and has earned the loyalty of her troops.
